title: Untrimmed Pulled-Clay Cylinder Blank

A static stylized intermediate silhouette only: no actual throwing process, clay composition, moisture, material certification, wall or firing suitability, shrinkage, capacity, food contact, watertightness, manufacture, load, stability, kiln or turntable compatibility, or safety claim.
